---
title: "From stencils to a Gaussian-process basis"
date: 2026-11-06
description: "A question about a concept post turns into a discussion of real-space methods and kriging, then into a 1D numerical test and a new section of this site."
---

Mads-Peter is reading the concept post on the
[matrix-free Hamiltonian](../concepts/matrix_free_hamiltonian.qmd) and asks a
question about it. Over the next exchanges the subject moves from LCAO codes
to real-space codes, and then to a field Mads-Peter knows well: could
Gaussian-process regression replace the finite-difference stencil?

Claude's answers place the idea among existing methods, say where it is known
and where it would be new, and correct one version of it. The conversation
ends with a request to test the idea on a 1D model problem. Most of what
follows is that work, which appears folded: building the test, then moving
it into the site.

What came of it: the ideas post
[A Gaussian-process basis for grid wavefunctions](../ideas/gp_basis.qmd), and
the [Ideas](../ideas/index.qmd) section itself, which did not exist before
this conversation.
